fact: The WHO Algeria office's 2020-2021 biennial report says WHO supported the Ministry of Health's Direction des systèmes d'information et de l'informatique (DSII) in 2020-2021 to train newly recruited staff in the use of the DHIS2 health information system, and counts 1,748 polycliniques and 6,160 salles de soins in 2020.
title: Rapport biennal 2020-2021
publisher: Organisation mondiale de la Santé, Bureau de l'Algérie
